results.title: JP Nadda Chairs Review On Delhis Preparedness For Influenza, Dengue And Malaria As Surveillance Stepped Up
results.description: Union Minister JP Nadda reviewed Delhi's preparedness for seasonal and vector-borne diseases as Delhi Health Minister Pankaj Singh said that capital reported 2392 influenza-A cases with H1N1 dominant, 246 dengue cases, and assured full hospital readiness.

results.title: Government Restricts FDCs Containing Chlorpheniramine and Phenylephrine for Young Children
results.description: The Government of India has implemented new restrictions regarding Fixed Dose Combinations (FDCs) that include the active ingredients Chlorpheniramine Maleate and Phenylephrine Hydrochloride. This initiative aims to protect the health and safety of children below the age of four years.
